Subject: Public health alert: 5 Measles cases in 3 days at Nairobi West Clinic

Possible Measles outbreak at Nairobi West Clinic

Afiax has counted 5 Measles cases in 3 days at Nairobi West Clinic, recorded by Nairobi West Clinic. That reaches the alert threshold of 5 cases, so it may be an outbreak and needs a response now.

You're getting this because this address is on the outbreak alert list for Nairobi West Clinic.

  Disease:               Measles (ICD-11 1F03)
  Where:                 Nairobi West Clinic
  Cases:                 5, of which 2 confirmed
  First and last case:   17 Nov 2026 to 19 Nov 2026
  Alert rule:            5 or more Measles cases within 3 days at the same facility
  Detected:              19 Nov 2026, 10:42 EAT
  Event reference:       PHE-20261119-measles-cluster-3f2a9c1b

THE CASES

  1. 17 Nov 2026 · confirmed · female, age 4 · Langata, Nairobi
  2. 18 Nov 2026 · provisional · male, age 2 · Langata, Nairobi
  3. 18 Nov 2026 · confirmed · male, age 7 · Kibra, Nairobi
  4. 19 Nov 2026 · provisional · female, age 1 · Langata, Nairobi
  5. 19 Nov 2026 · provisional · unknown · Nairobi

Names, ID numbers and contact details are left out to protect patients. Staff at Nairobi West Clinic can see the full records in Afiax.

WHAT TO DO NOW

1. Notify the Sub-County and County Disease Surveillance Coordinators immediately
2. Verify the cases and collect specimens for laboratory confirmation
3. Conduct active case search and line-list all cases
4. Institute control measures appropriate to the disease

If you have an Afiax account at Nairobi West Clinic, the event report with links to each case is here:
https://app.afiax.africa/DocumentReference/7a1b2c3d-0000-4c1b-8a3e-2f6d7c8b9a01

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

Afiax has opened a public health event and a follow-up task for Nairobi West Clinic. If more Measles cases are recorded at Nairobi West Clinic while the event is open, they're added to it. You won't get a separate email for each one.
